in_marathi.name: Ishavari
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of grace
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ishavari हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ishavari is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘Ish’ meaning god and ‘Var’ meaning grace. This name signifies the embodiment of grace and divine blessings. In Hindu mythology, Ishavari is revered as the goddess of compassion and grace, who bestows her blessings upon her devotees.
